evidence_spans: The classifier achieves 72% cross-provider accuracy, demonstrating that the extracted side-channel signatures capture underlying, machine-independent structural characteristics of the models rather than platform-specific noise.
We train an Extra-Trees classifier (500 estimators) exclusively on the CloudLab dataset (80 traces per model)
and evaluate it on the Lambda dataset (20 traces per model).
Unless otherwise stated, all experiments are performed on a GH200 node from CloudLab [27] running NVIDIA driver version 590.48.01 and CUDA Toolkit 12.2.
CLM-ARCH-0097.statement: The Extra-Trees classifier achieves 72% cross-provider accuracy when trained on CloudLab data and evaluated on Lambda Cloud data.

extra_quotes: We construct the eviction set using the following procedure: the target page is first accessed N−δ times, bringing its counter close to the migration threshold; then M distractor pages are accessed; finally, the target page is accessed again to determine whether migration is triggered, following the methodology of previous experiments.
Its main drawback is that it relies purely on software-level contention, which makes it unstable across runs, primarily because the contention level is difficult to control.
